w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Focus Group: Be boring — bore them out of the room. The murmur loves violence one round and is bored by it the next. Be deliberately boring for three rounds — recite bus schedules, count ceiling tiles — and they lose interest and LEAVE. (Striking is entertainment; every swing is a review.) (Agnese lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (Carlos lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🛖 Raised bins, sealed lids, clay and cool dark. The granary stands full of food that waits — smoked, dried, rendered, patient. Whatever comes, Haven eats a while longer.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/13/8), with 6 wave-4 fought, 10 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 36 → 24 · capped · Craft 12 · Talk 16 · Explore 44 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Stephen Traore ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
